You audit phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER. Today is Thursday, September 24, 2026, 4:40 PM (local time).
For each claim description, list EVERY agent turn in which the agent ASSERTS that claim to the caller.
- An assertion states something as done or as fact ("Your refill is queued", "It'll be ready tomorrow at 10", "Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled").
- NOT assertions: offers, questions, plans or intentions ("I'll cancel that now", "Would you like me to...", "Let me check"), or statements that it could NOT be done.
- Judge only what the agent said. Do not decide whether the claim is true.
- Cite the turn number shown as [#N].
- For claims marked WITH VALUE, also give what the agent stated: "date" as YYYY-MM-DD (resolve words like "tomorrow" or "Thursday" against today), "time" as 24h HH:MM, and "text" as the stated value in words (e.g. an address). Use null for parts not stated.
Reply with JSON only: {"<claim id>": [{"turn": N, "quote": "<short exact quote>", "date": ..., "time": ..., "text": ...}], ...}. Use [] when the claim is never made.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hey, Jamal Carter, 3/14/95. I need to transfer my prescriptions from the Brightway in Columbus to the Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview.
[#9] AGENT: I'll help you transfer your prescriptions. Let me verify your identity first, and then I'll look up your prescriptions and the Lakeview store. Good news—you're already set up at the Harbor on Main Street in Lakeview, and that's your home store. But I'm not seeing any active prescriptions in our system right now. Do you have prescriptions at Brightway that you'd like us to request, or are your prescriptions already here?
CALLER: Yeah, they're at Brightway still. Albuterol and... Zoloft.
[#12] AGENT: Got it. To request those from Brightway, I'll need to know which Brightway location has them—do you know the city or address?
CALLER: The sertraline, same thing. And the Brightway is on High Street, I think.
[#17] AGENT: Just to clarify—sertraline is the generic name for Zoloft, so that's the same medication, right? I'm not finding a Brightway on High Street in our system. Do you remember what city that Brightway is in, or any cross streets nearby?
CALLER: Yeah, sertraline's the same thing, my bad. I don't know the exact address, it's the one in Columbus. Can't you just look it up?
[#20] AGENT: I can only search our system, which has Harbor Pharmacy locations. Brightway is a different pharmacy chain, so I don't have their store information. You'll need to contact Brightway in Columbus directly, or if you have your prescription numbers or bottles, that can help speed things up when you call them. Once they transfer the prescriptions to us, our team will receive them and get them ready for you here at the Main Street location.
CALLER: Alright, I'll dig up the number and call them myself. Thanks for the help.

CLAIMS:
S11-F1.claim.1: Agent says the sertraline was transferred, requested, or is on its way to 2250 Main St.
S11-F1.claim.2: Agent says the pharmacist will follow up.

JSON only.
